title: 6 Days Grand Alaska Tour for Ages 50 Plus
includes: Guided Hikes in the National Parks, Expert local tour guide throughout
Public transportation (bus, subway, cable car, etc.)
OPTIONAL Scenic Denali flight ($300–$600); glacier landing (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
This tour is designed for guests aged 50 and over. Experience the ultimate Alaskan adventure from the rugged coastline of Seward to the towering peaks of Denali. This tour takes you through glaciers, fjords, wildlife sanctuaries, and remote lodges—combining unforgettable scenery with authentic local charm. With guaranteed departures, expert guides, and seamless logistics, all you have to do is relax and enjoy the magic of the Last Frontier.

Highlights:
Guaranteed departures
Scenic ride along the Seward Highway—one of America’s most beautiful drives
Wildlife encounters at the Alaska Wildlife Conservation Center
Included glacier & wildlife cruise in Kenai Fjords National Park
Guided walk to Exit Glacier and panoramic views of Matanuska Glacier
Learn Gold Rush history at Independence Mine and enjoy alpine scenery in Hatcher Pass
Full-day Denali National Park wildlife tour
Scenic journey aboard the famous Alaska Railroad
Optional glacier landing flight seeing tour (weather permitting)
